subject: Stan used in rapid research paper on H7N9 influenza

messages.author: f9ac114033008096
messages.subject: Stan used in rapid research paper on H7N9 influenza
parts:
I thought you'd all like to know that Stan was used and referenced in a peer-reviewed Rapid Communications paper on influenza, which is now online here: http://www.eurosurveillance.org/ViewArticle.aspx?ArticleId=20475 

Thank you for this excellent modelling language and sampler, which made it possible to carry out this work quickly!

Guy
